ns2:section.sectionText: This course will meet in BIF 4001. Social science research draws from a variety of methodological traditions. In this course we will examine how scholarship can benefit from fieldwork and historical methods. We will examine mixed-methods approaches (e.g., using fieldwork to guide and contextualize or understand findings from archival research), as well as how to effectively use these methods independent of other methods. Course participants will read both methodological and illustrative pieces from the literature, and gain experience hand-collecting data from primary sources and archives.
